question: Who among the following personalities is associated with Odissi dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Surupa Sen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Surupa Sen is a renowned Indian classical dancer and choreographer who is associated with the classical dance form of Odissi.
 
• She is the Artistic Director of the Nrityagram Dance Ensemble, which is one of the most respected institutions for Indian classical dance.
 
• Surupa Sen has been trained under the legendary Odissi dancer, Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra.
 
• She has received several prestigious awards for her contribution to the field of Odissi dance, including the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi Dance**

 
 
• Odissi is one of the eight classical dance forms of India, originating from the state of Odisha.
 
• It is known for its fluid movements, intricate gestures, and strong footwork.
 
• The dance is characterized by its sculpturesque poses and the tribhangi posture, which involves the independent movement of the head, chest, and pelvis.
 
• Odissi dance is traditionally performed to Odia music and is deeply rooted in the region's culture and religious traditions.
 
 
 
• **Jatin Goswami**
 
 
• Jatin Goswami is an Indian classical dancer and choreographer associated with the Sattriya dance form.
 
• Sattriya is one of the eight principal classical Indian dance traditions and originates from Assam.
 
 
 
• **Yamini Krishnamurthy**
 
 
• Yamini Krishnamurthy is a renowned Indian classical dancer famous for her expertise in Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi dance forms.
 
• Bharatanatyam is a classical dance form from Tamil Nadu, while Kuchipudi is from Andhra Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Ishira Parikh**
 
 
• Ishira Parikh is an Indian classical dancer known for her proficiency in Kathak.
 
• Kathak is one of the eight classical dance forms of India, originating from North India and characterized by its intricate footwork and spins.
